fields.subject: NRC, SERC, LEPC, DEP Release Report — Submitted
fields.body:
To: Incident Commander

This is to confirm that the reportable chlorine release at Rail Spot 2 has been formally submitted to all required regulatory agencies.

The release was estimated at 1,200 lbs, based on scale rise (WT-302), visible plume, and field confirmation. The cause remains under investigation, but no fatalities or injuries have been reported.

The following reports were submitted via the appropriate channels:

- National Response Center (NRC) via Form 401 (800-424-8802), submission number: 20261024-111512-0047
- West Virginia SERC (24-hour line) and LEPC community emergency coordinator (Annex A)
- West Virginia Department of Environmental Protection (DEP) spill line

All contact logs are documented in Form ERP-5.1, attached to the official record. The holding statement (ERP-8) has been approved by the Incident Commander and is being distributed to media and community contacts.

The EHS Manager has initiated the 24-hour OSHA reporting window for potential in-patient hospitalization, pending further medical assessment.

The incident remains under active investigation. Do not alter any control system states until further notice.

Best regards,

EHS Manager
